Exposure to banking, financial services, or regulated industry control frameworks is preferred. Understanding of Information Security domains including Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, Cloud Security, and Cybersecurity Controls. Strong knowledge of risk management frameworks such as COSO, Three Lines of Defense, NIST, and related control standards. Advanced Excel skills for sampling, testing analysis, and risk reporting. Ability to create high-quality, audit-defensible, regulator-ready documentation and working papers.
